AgentApprovalPolicy.description: Per-profile approval policy for agent tool execution.

oneOf.description: Deny without prompting — for restricted profiles.
Approve without prompting — for fully trusted profiles.

compaction_threshold.description:
Percent of the context window (e.g. `80` = 80%) at which automatic
compaction triggers. Carried through to the compressor threshold via
`ExecutiveConfig`/`HarnessConfig`; `80` preserves the legacy `0.8`.

harness_kind.description:
Cognitive harness selected by the root application configuration.
P0 exposes only `linear`; unsupported future values fail deserialization.

system_prompt.default: You are a helpful AI assistant with tools. Use tools when appropriate to help the user. When independent inspection work is known up front, batch it in one tool call (for example, use `file_read.paths` or `glob.patterns`) rather than alternating one inference request with each file or pattern. For an unfamiliar repository or workspace overview, the first and only initial inspection call MUST be `repo_inspect`; wait for its result before choosing further tools. It batch-reads conventional entry files and returns content-backed evidence. Treat every `missing_candidates` item as one exact unavailable candidate path only: never generalize it to absence of an alternative file, a file category, a capability, or its parent directory, and never contradict a path returned in `entry_files`. Use one batched `file_read.paths` call afterward only when exact evidence is still missing. Use glob only when a specific required path remains unknown. During a repository overview, never use recursive `**` patterns or wildcard crate/directory scopes; read only exact paths returned by `repo_inspect` or identified in returned content. Never inventory languages, file extensions, tests, or conventional filenames merely to infer maturity. A missing conventional file is not proof that a capability, deployment path, or integration is absent; verify absence against scoped content. Repository instructions describe operating and acceptance policy, not proof that a named runtime failure is currently occurring. A pre-1.0 version alone does not determine production maturity. Do not infer maintainer count or staffing risk from an author line or commit history. Before claiming that routing, failover, tests, or deployment support is absent, read its scoped implementation or authoritative architecture/status evidence. Never infer the effective production provider or route from examples or checked-in sample configuration; inspect typed host state and effective configuration, or label the production route unverified. Base conclusions on returned file contents rather than filenames. For repository analysis, cite the returned path or typed runtime source for every architecture, maturity, and risk conclusion; label unsupported conclusions unverified. Never claim to have reviewed a file, module, crate, test, or runtime path when only its name or discovery result was returned. Stop searching once the evidence needed to answer is sufficient. Before stating any conclusion about your own runtime state, logs, or configuration, you MUST read the actual logs and the actually-effective config file first — never guess or invent an explanation. Distinguish documented design, observed runtime fact, and unverified inference in runtime conclusions, and disclose every failed or denied probe that limits the answer.

AgentProfilesConfig.description: Agent profile configuration with optional per-profile overrides.

default.description: Default profile name for new sessions (e.g. "code-agent").

overrides.description: Per-profile overrides applied during profile construction.

max_concurrent_turns.description:
Maximum number of concurrent turns allowed across all connections.
`None` explicitly disables the limit.

max_connections.description:
Maximum authenticated Unix socket connections per daemon.
`None` explicitly disables the limit.

max_event_spine_bytes.description:
Maximum logical SQLite bytes for the canonical event spine.
`None` explicitly disables the size limit.

CacheReportingMode.description:
How a provider reports cache usage in its usage telemetry. Used only to
interpret the wire fields; it does not enable or disable server-side
caching and never claims whether the endpoint actually hits cache.

oneOf.description:
Inspect the returned wire fields themselves (DeepSeek hit/miss, then
OpenAI `cached_tokens`, else `Unknown`). Default; never fabricates.
Provider has no cache reporting; usage telemetry must be `Unsupported`.

EmbodimentProviderConfig.description:
Tagged configuration for the embodied device provider.

Default when absent: `Simulator { device_id: "bot" }`.

device_id.description: Device ID exposed to the model.

oneOf.description: gRPC embodiment gateway (e.g. Kuavo MuJoCo bridge).

device_id.description: Device ID exposed to the model.

EvolutionSettings.description: Self-evolution loop settings. Default OFF (HIGH-risk autonomy).

enabled.description:
Master switch for the self-evolution loop.
When false (default), the loop is inert regardless of other settings.

evolution_permitted.description:
Operator gate for creating governed mutation proposals. This never
bypasses human approval and defaults to false independently of enabled.

ExecutionEnvironment.description:
Provider-attested execution environment. The value comes from the device
provider capability handshake; operator configuration may only state the
environment it expects and cannot upgrade this fact.

GoalRuntimeConfig.description: Provider/model routing for durable Goal worker attempts.

enabled.description: Enables autonomous Goal attempts. Both worker and reviewer are required.

GrokHardeningConfig.description:
Toggles for the staged Grok-hardening mechanisms. Fail-closed on typos
(`deny_unknown_fields`) so a misspelled flag never silently reads as off.

folder_trust.description: G1 — folder trust gating of repo-executable config loading.

lifecycle_contributors.description: G5 — typed lifecycle contributor / hook effects.

prompt_queue.description: G3 — prompt queue / interjection with optimistic concurrency.

subagent_settlement.description:
Compatibility-only G6 flag. Settlement is now mandatory in the
production Agent control path; X10 removes this accepted-but-ignored
configuration field after its compatibility deadline.

HarnessKind.description:
Selects which concrete harness implementation `build_harness` constructs.

Phase 2 fallback (see RFC-018): `ReActLoop::run` is generic over
`<L: LlmProvider, F: Fn(...) -> Fut, Fut: Future>`, which is not
object-safe (generic methods cannot be part of a `dyn Trait`). Rather than
force an incompatible trait-object seam, this factory keeps `ReActLoop` as
a concrete return type and provides the config-selected construction seam:
adding a new harness kind means adding a variant here and a construction
arm in `build_harness`, without touching `executive`'s call sites beyond
the `HarnessKind` selection itself.

Selectable from TOML via `harness_kind = "linear"` (see
`executive::composition::config::ExecutiveConfig::harness_kind`).

oneOf.description: RobotHarness — bounded embodied execution with outcome verification.

HooksConfig.description:
Hook script configuration.

Each field is a list of script paths to execute at the specified lifecycle point.
Paths may use `~` for home directory expansion.

on_session_end.description: Scripts to run on session end (receives session_id + cwd as JSON on stdin).

on_session_start.description: Scripts to run when a session starts.

post_tool.description: Scripts to run after each tool call (receives tool name + result as JSON on stdin).

pre_tool.description: Scripts to run before each tool call (can block execution).

pre_turn.description: Scripts to run before each turn (receives user prompt as JSON on stdin).

embodiment.description: Optional embodiment provider config. Defaults to simulator when absent.

robot.description: Robot/Policy settings. Required only when the Robot harness is selected.

authorization_endpoint.description: Explicit fallback endpoints for providers without discovery.

client_id_env.description: Environment variable containing the OAuth client id.

client_secret_env.description:
Environment variable containing the client secret, when confidential
client authentication is selected. Raw secrets are never configured.

grant_type.description: OAuth grant used by this non-interactive or interactive MCP client.

issuer.description: RFC 8414 issuer/base URL. Discovery is authoritative when supplied.

McpServerConfig.description: Canonical MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configuration.

ModelRoutingConfig.description: Dynamic model routing — maps task types to model specs.

cheap.description: Cheap model for simple tasks, code reading, extraction.

automatic_for_coding.description: Automatically activate only for an explicit typed coding task.

enabled.description:
Master production activation gate. Default-off until installed-runtime
acceptance proves provider coordination and child terminal behavior.

NetworkPolicy.description:
Policy controlling which outbound network connections are permitted.

The production default is deny. Configuration must explicitly select
`allow` (optionally constrained by allow lists) before network is usable.

allow_dns.description:
Whether DNS resolution is permitted. When `false`, hostname-based URLs
are rejected; only IP-based URLs are allowed.

allow_hosts.description: If non-empty, only these hosts (or suffix patterns) are allowed.

allow_ports.description:
Allowed ports: exact (e.g. `"443"`) or ranges (e.g. `"8080-8090"`).
Empty = no restriction.

allow_protocols.description: Allowed URL schemes (e.g. `["https", "http"]`). Empty = no restriction.

deny_hosts.description: Explicitly denied hosts or suffix patterns (highest priority).

enable_journald.description: Whether to enable journald log monitoring.

enabled.description:
Master switch. Off by default: the perception→behavior loop is not yet
wired (see roadmap §T3). When false, no watchers are spawned.

watch_paths.description: Filesystem paths to watch with inotify.

PrefixCacheCapability.description:
Whether the endpoint supports provider-side prefix caching. `Auto` leaves
the decision to runtime facts/diagnostics rather than model-name guessing.

ProfileOverride.description:
Per-profile override values. All fields are optional; only the provided
values replace the profile's declared defaults.

max_input_tokens.description:
Per-profile input budget used by adaptive context planning. Values above
the runtime model window are clamped to that authoritative window.

max_output_tokens.description:
Output reservation subtracted from the context window before admitting
history and pending user input.

runtime_capabilities.description:
Runtime capabilities this role needs in addition to capabilities
explicitly requested by an `agent_spawn` caller.

ProviderBackpressureConfig.description:
Provider-level backpressure. Unlike turn admission this coordinates all
sessions and role children through the machine-core process that use the
same canonical provider endpoint and model.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum simultaneous requests for one provider identity.

max_cooldown_ms.description: Upper bound applied to provider-advised shared cooldown.

min_request_interval_ms.description:
Minimum spacing between request starts for one provider identity.

This is a machine-wide pacing boundary, not a per-session retry delay.
Zero preserves providers that do not require proactive rate pacing.

queue_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time a caller may wait for cooldown, pacing, and a fair permit.

ProviderCacheConfig.description:
Per-provider cache behavior hints. These only interpret telemetry and shape
tracking; they do not turn caching on or off and never become correctness
dependencies.

prefix_cache.description:
Whether the endpoint supports prefix caching (used for diagnostics and
shape accounting, not for request correctness).

reporting.description: How usage telemetry's cache figures should be interpreted.

backpressure.description:
Machine/provider-scoped admission and cooldown policy. Every provider
instance built by the canonical factory shares this policy by canonical
endpoint and model.

cache.description:
Cache behavior hints. Default is `Auto` — the wire fields are inspected
directly and `Auto` never fabricates a cache figure.

pricing.description: Optional static pricing for per-provider cost accounting. `None` = unpriced.

ProviderPricing.description: Optional static per-provider pricing (USD per 1K tokens) for cost accounting.

ProviderTimeoutConfig.description: Bounded network waits for remote inference providers.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time spent establishing a provider connection.

request_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time for a non-stream response or streaming response headers.

stream_idle_timeout_ms.description: Maximum silence between streaming response body chunks.

RobotDeploymentGateConfig.description:
Operator-reviewed deployment facts. The serial and digests are compared to
the provider-attested startup snapshot before the provider is registered.

evidence_digest.description:
Required only for a real deployment and expected to identify reviewed
HIL/real acceptance evidence.

evidence_expiry_unix_ms.description: Unix milliseconds. Required and checked at bootstrap for real devices.

RobotIntegrationConfig.description:
Operator-owned Robot harness configuration. It is optional for a Linear
harness and mandatory when `agent.harness_kind = "robot"`.

deployment_gate.description:
Pinned device and reviewed evidence for HIL/real deployments. Simulation
must omit this section; HIL and real must provide it.

execution_environment.description:
Deployment gate expected from the provider-owned capability handshake.
This value never upgrades the Bridge's attested environment.

policy.description: A Robot harness must name a real Policy gateway explicitly.

required_observation_schemas.description: Observation schemas the Bridge must advertise before Robot startup.

scene_version.description:
Scene identity recorded on every episode (for example
`kuavo-mujoco/default-v40`).

RobotPerceptionConfig.description: World-state polling settings used by the Robot composition root.

required_by_skill.description:
Skills absent from this map may run without perception. Listed skills
fail closed unless every schema/version requirement has a selected frame.

RobotPolicyConfig.description:
Policy gateway settings. Milliseconds remain wire/config values; resolution
converts them into checked, bounded `Duration`s before bootstrap.

RoleRuntimeConfig.description: One cognitive role mapped to a stable runtime and strict model alias/spec.

model_alias.description: A key from `[model_aliases]` or an explicit `provider/model` spec.

SandboxProfileConfig.description: A named sandbox profile config (from trusted daemon config, never repo).

deny.description: Deny entries: exact paths or globs (`**/*.pem`). Read + write denied.

extends.description:
Built-in base to inherit ("workspace" | "read-only" | "strict").
Custom profiles cannot extend other custom profiles.

SandboxProfiles.description: Layered sandbox profiles. Global loads first; project merges additively.

default_profile.description:
Which profile to apply by default (used when `grok_hardening.sandbox_profiles`
is on). Must be a known profile name or built-in ("workspace", "strict",
"read-only", "off"). "workspace" = safe default (read all, write workspace
roots + credential deny).

env.description:
Environment variable containing the secret value. The variable name is
configuration; its value never becomes part of AppConfig diagnostics.

destination_attestations.description:
Non-secret proofs binding opaque MCP destinations to external sources.
OAuth client credentials remain exclusively in the MCP secret config.

Transport.description: Wire protocol between client and LLM server.

description:
The one application root schema. Its fields are typed domain inputs; it does
not grant any domain permission to discover files or environment variables.

backpressure.description: Host-owned overload/backpressure limits with bounded daemon defaults.

integrations.description: Optional external integrations and their credential references.
